caption: The drawing depicts two wooden objects, both cylindrical and elongated, positioned vertically on a light beige background. The object on the left is slightly longer and thinner, with a consistent width along its length and rounded ends. The object on the right is thicker, with a slightly irregular, natural wood texture, and has its upper portion wrapped with several bands of different colored materials, including brown, green, and possibly dark red. Both objects appear to be made of wood, with visible grain patterns and shading that suggest a smooth, weathered surface. Near the bottom right of the drawing, the artist’s name "ARCHIE THOMPSON" is printed in small, capitalized letters. The composition is centered within a lighter rectangular frame that itself sits on a subtly shaded, larger beige background.
title: Bishop Hill: Flail
